defs.def: the father of your father or mother （外）祖父；爷爷；外公

ex.s: It was ten miles from her home to her grandfather’s, and that always seemed like a long way, even in a car!
ex.t: 从她家到祖父家有十英里，即使坐车，那似乎也总是很长的一段路！

ex.s: She credits these skills to her late grandfather and builder Derek Lloyd.
ex.t: 她把这些技能归功于她已故的祖父、建筑工德里克·劳埃德。

ex.s: Why did Terri’s grandfather give her £ 5 a day?
ex.t: 特里的外祖父为什么每天给她5英镑？
一件古董，比如你的祖父。

ex.s: Anyway, grandpa is now an internet star—two minutes of fame!
ex.t: 不管怎样，爷爷现在是个网络明星——两分钟的名气！

ex.s: He was angry with his grandpa.
What did Peter learn from his grandfather?
ex.t: Peter从他祖父那里学到了什么？

ex.t: 斯通教授的祖父害怕什么？

ex.s: My grandpa said last summer they earned quite a lot by sell the fish.
ex.t: 爷爷说去年夏天他们卖鱼赚了相当多钱。

ex.s: He had told me that his grandfather was "really wicked".
ex.t: 他告诉我他祖父真的很坏。

ex.s: But when I met his grandfather, I liked him a lot.
ex.t: 但当我见到他祖父时，我非常喜欢他。

ex.s: Grandfather and Father, seated at the table, are playing chess.) Grandfather: And...I win!
ex.t: 坐在桌旁的爷爷和父亲正在下棋。）爷爷：还有……我赢了！

ex.s: Grandfather: (stepping between Father and Son and raising his voice) Hey!
ex.t: 祖父：（拦在父亲和儿子之间，提高声音）嘿！
